title: Master of the Misty Waters - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Master of the Misty Waters trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Master of the Misty Waters phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One trophy, three fights, all in the Meigu Lake region. Drops include the Loong Trident.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat Blackwater Leader You Loong, Zither Maiden Yan Qiansui and the One-Eyed Archer.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 34 of 36 on the list - before it A Thousand Cups Drained · after it The Two Blade Masters. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
